newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: POLL - 220,000 jobs created in greater Buenos Aires.
newsitem.headline: POLL - 220,000 jobs created in greater Buenos Aires.

text.p: A total of 220,000 jobs were created over the last year in greater Buenos Aires, bringing the size of the labor force in that area to 5.1 million people, according to a poll published Thursday.
The survey of 2,635 people by Manuel Mora y Araujo in Clarin newspaper showed the number of unemployed people in the area decreased by 100,000 since October.
The government is scheduled Friday to announce its semi-annual report on national unemployment, which is widely expected to show a decrease of about one percentage point from 17.3 percent.
